steps.name: the synthetic member with a long right-to-left name: created, its stars and review written through its own session (the password random, kept nowhere)
steps.script: const old = (await ApiClient.getUsers()).filter(u => u.Name === "عضو تجريبي باسم طويل جدا للتحقق من العزل في قائمة الإشراف rtl9"); for (const u of old) { await ApiClient.deleteUser(u.Id); } const pw = Array.from(crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(18)), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); const user = await ApiClient.createUser({ Name: "عضو تجريبي باسم طويل جدا للتحقق من العزل في قائمة الإشراف rtl9", Password: pw }); const head = 'MediaBrowser Client="mod-webcheck", Device="webcheck", DeviceId="mod-webcheck-' + Date.now() + '", Version="1.0.0"'; const auth = await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Users/AuthenticateByName'), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: head }, body: JSON.stringify({ Username: "عضو تجريبي باسم طويل جدا للتحقق من العزل في قائمة الإشراف rtl9", Pw: pw }) }); if (auth.status !== 200) { throw new Error('sign-in ' + auth.status); } const token = (await auth.json()).AccessToken; const put = (p, b) => fetch(ApiClient.getUrl(p), { method: 'PUT', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: head + ', Token="' + token + '"' }, body: JSON.stringify(b) }).then(r => r.status); const s1 = await put('UserRatings/Items/' + __vars.movieId + '/Mine/Rating', { Stars: 2.5 }); const s2 = await put('UserRatings/Items/' + __vars.movieId + '/Mine/Review', { Text: "mod webcheck review R: مراجعة قصيرة من عضو تجريبي.", IsSpoiler: false }); await fetch(ApiClient.getUrl('Sessions/Logout'), { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: head + ', Token="' + token + '"' } }); if (s1 !== 200 || s2 !== 200) { throw new Error('rating ' + s1 + ', review ' + s2); } return { id: user.Id, statuses: [s1, s2] };
